ios.desc:
Transform your device into a powerful 3D scanner using LIDAR or TrueDepth technology.

3D Scanner app, downloaded by 11+ Million users, effortlessly makes you capture spaces and objects in full-color 3D and explore them in stunning, high-quality detail.

Easily share your 3D scans
Share your 3D models via iMessage or AR QuickLook in USDZ format, or export them in popular formats like OBJ, GLTF, GLB, DAE, and STL.

Export in advanced formats
Beyond standard exports, you can save your models as raw point clouds (PTS, PCD, PLY, XYZ, LAS) or floor plan images in DXF format, giving you full flexibility for professional workflows.

Seamless integration with professional software
Export geo-referenced LAS point clouds to GIS tools like ArcGIS or transfer raw scan data (including photos) to photogrammetry software such as Pix4D or Reality Capture.

Edit directly on your device
Refine, crop, and perfect your scans directly on your device for maximum control and precision.

Accurate scans for any space or object
Capture your home, garden, or any environment in 3D with LIDAR support. Easily import your scans into 3D modeling software like Blender, 3ds Max, SketchUp, Maya, and more. Use RoomPlan mode for quick floor plans, or TrueDepth mode for smaller, detailed objects.

Capture ultra-detailed scans with Photo Mode
Leverage our advanced "Photo Mode" to create highly detailed models using Apple’s Object Capture photogrammetry API.

Intuitive sharing and measuring tools
Share your 3D models effortlessly with the new "Share to Web" feature. Measure your scans with a virtual ruler or create bounding boxes to precisely calculate dimensions such as width, length, and height.

Discover the power of the LIDAR sensor
Transform your device into a real-time LIDAR scanner and unlock next-level accuracy and detail.

View your scans in AR
Visualize all your saved scans in an immersive augmented reality viewer for a truly interactive experience.

3D Scanner App is the perfect companion to Sweet Home 3D, enabling you to design, capture, and visualize your dream home with precision and ease. Its 3D scanning technology is supported in Sweet Home 3D, as the generated models can be easily imported and integrated into your projects.

Subscribe to access to premium app features; subscription details are the following:

- Length: weekly, yearly
- Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase

quotes.text:
I’ve used this: https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/3d-scanner-app/id1419913995?l=en

Some places like IKEA will let you get a model of the furniture that you can drop into something like Blender to see how it fits.

When scanning my wife’s childhood home we found enough space for a large hidden room in the house. We couldn’t figure out how to access it without looking too suspicious (we didn’t want anyone to know we knew).

quotes.text:
I've been using 3D Scanner App [0] for almost two years now. And it has been free and very feature rich this whole time. So many very helpful export options, as well as a nice frontend. I've also made use of getting the raw data here and there. Its hard for me to tell what this adds over that. And like another comment points out, this looks like a thin wrapper over the tools already provided by Apple.

[0]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/3d-scanner-app/id1419913995
If you have a compatible mac there are several free apps like this one: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/3d-scanner-app/id1419913995

PolyCam is apparently not free but considered one of the best. I used 3D Scanner from Laan labs (& it's a free app. No ads thankfully). I used it to build a few dataset for NeRFs based on MIPNeRF. The data quality seemed pretty fine. I use a iPad Pro with M1 btw.
